source_title: Clutch Chess: Why is Praggnanandhaa still in contention despite finishing last on Day 1? - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Anerican grandmaster Hikaru Nakamura made an impressive return to competitive chess, taking the early lead at the Clutch Chess Champions Showdown 2026 after the opening day on Tuesday. However, despite ending the day at the bottom of the standings, Indian grandmaster Rameshbabu Praggnanandhaa remains firmly in contention, thanks to the tournamentâs unique scoring system.After three rounds, Nakamura leads the field with 4 points, followed by Javokhir Sindarov on 3.5 points and Fabiano Caruana on 2.5 points. Praggnanandhaa sits fourth with 2 points, but the competition is far from over.How Clutch Chess format keeps Pragg in raceA brainchild of grandmaster Maurice Ashley, the tournamentâs format offers players a significant opportunity to make up lost ground.Each victory on Day 1 earns one point and $1,000, while wins on Day 2 are worth two points and $2,000. On the final day, every win carries three points and $3,000.This progressive scoring system means that strong performances in the remaining rounds could dramatically change the leaderboard.Praggnanandhaa, therefore, has every reason to fight back, as victories on the second and third days will carry considerably more weight than those on the opening day.A difficult start for PraggnanandhaaPraggnanandhaaâs opening day was far from ideal. He lost his first game against Sindarov after making a critical mistake under time pressure and subsequently losing on time.He then suffered defeats against Nakamura and Caruana in their respective encounters, struggling to find consistency throughout the day.Nakamura, meanwhile, remained unbeaten, recording two wins and four draws to establish an early advantage. Sindarov also enjoyed a solid day, while Caruana managed to collect 2.5 points.Despite his setbacks, Praggnanandhaa, who had just two draws in the first two rounds against Sindarov and Nakamura, respectively, ended the day on a positive note by defeating Caruana in their final encounter.The victory could provide a much-needed confidence boost heading into Day 2.Can Praggnanandhaa stage a comeback?With higher points available in the remaining two days, Praggnanandhaaâs chances of challenging for the title remain alive.
